overview: The Medford School Committee received a self-evaluation and goals update from the interim superintendent, approved the 2026-2027 school year calendar, and reviewed the educational planning progress of the high school building project.

items.title: Postponement of Officer Elections
items.summary: The Committee approved a resolution to defer the election of its officers for the 2026-2027 term to the next scheduled meeting, keeping the existing officers in place in the interim.

items.title: Swearing-In Clarification
items.summary: Member Graham explained that she and Member Olapade would abstain from votes during the meeting because they missed the afternoon window to be officially sworn in.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The Committee approved the consent agenda, which included payroll approvals, capital purchases, donations, grants, field trips, and minutes from the December 15, 2025 meeting.

items.title: Interim Superintendent Evaluation and Goals
items.summary: Interim Superintendent Dr. Suzanne Galusi presented her self-evaluation and goals, detailing efforts to establish academic stability, reorganize leadership, improve school safety protocols, and roll out the OpenArchitects data analytics platform.

items.title: Approval of the 2026-2027 School Year Calendar
items.summary: The Committee approved Option A for the 2026-2027 school district calendar, setting the first day of school for September 2, 2026, and scheduling high school graduation for June 4, 2027.

items.title: Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee Update
items.summary: Member Graham detailed the project's educational planning sessions, site surveying, space requirements, and the timeline for upcoming community design forums.

items.title: Student Advisory Council and Condolences
items.summary: Student representative Alachie Yeager invited high school students to share community concerns, followed by the Committee reading condolences for several former educators and relatives of school staff.
